tips.text: Join an established clan whose Tenno Lab already has Daikyu researched and just pay the 15,000 credits.
Plan about a week of lab time in a brand-new solo clan; Akstiletto research must finish before Daikyu research starts.
Slot Vile Acceleration or Speed Trigger while levelling; it only fires at full charge and levels slowly.
Expect no farm at all; replicate it in a researched dojo and build it straight away.
